recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait framed within a large central circle, featuring a warm orange-to-red color cast on the subjects against a contrasting lavender textured background. The composition uses a layered approach with a prominent stylized logo overlapping the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm-toned subjects inside a circular portal against a cool-toned square background
Central figure flanked by two slightly recessed figures forming a triangle
High-contrast black and white clothing against saturated orange skin tones
Graphic logo anchored in the lower third, breaking the circular frame
coreInvariants: Sharp black outlines on primary typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered, waist-up, filling the majority of the circular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large yellow-backed logo in the lower foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the central face, moves outward to the flanking figures, then down to the primary logo, and finally up to the arched secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Lavender corners outside the circle provide breathing room for the central saturated elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center circle with lower value/muted saturation in the lavender surround.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses high-contrast serifs with elongated, sharp terminals
Secondary text follows the curve of the circular frame in a loose script
Primary text is integrated into a jagged, glowing yellow shape
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter features an exaggerated descender that curves under the following letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a casual script for decorative framing.
graphicDevices: Circular frame with thin green/yellow border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the casual, arched secondary text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of three women in 90s fashion (blazers, white shirts) with a heavy orange and red duotone filter. Place them inside a large circle. The area outside the circle should be a textured lavender purple. The circle should have a thin, multi-colored glowing border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stylized black serif logo in the lower third. The logo should be backed by a jagged, glowing yellow airbrushed shape. Add a secondary script text arched along the top curve of the circle in black.

verificationChecks: Is the central color palette dominated by orange/red tones?
Does the lavender background have a subtle paper-like texture?
Is the main logo placed in the lower foreground overlapping the subjects?
Is the circular frame clearly defined?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange color wash
Sharpness of the yellow logo glow
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Vibrant color contrast between center and edges
Graphic integration of text and image
avoid: Desaturated or pastel palettes in the center
Centered text without a backing graphic

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange wash doesn't bleed into the lavender background
Check that the yellow glow behind the logo looks airbrushed, not a hard vector shape
Verify the trio forms a cohesive group composition
Confirm the circular frame is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Trio portrait + Circular Portal + Warm/Cool Color Contrast + Airbrushed Logo Backing
